parallax._doc: 3D backgrounds (0.083, core/bg3d.js): depth maps in assets/bg/depth/ (tools/gen-depth.py). depthScale = how far depth pushes the art along each camera ray; pivot = the depth that stays still; yaw/pitch = sway amplitude in degrees; periods in seconds; overscan = skirt beyond the screen edge; overrides = per-file tweaks keyed by background filename. joltDeg = the small camera kick on heavy blows; swayDeg = the rocking rotation (about the depth centre) on the biggest blows (0.092/0.093; crits, SMASH, multi-kills swing the near art right, hits on the knight of at least swayHitShare of max HP swing it left). depthFiles = per-background depth map filename when regenerated (new name, never overwrite). fog (0.099, core/bg3dFog.js) = depth-embedded mist: distance haze + three drifting wisp sheets, amount per background in overrides (long exterior views more, rooms a touch), colour from the scene's own far pixels (fogColor [r,g,b] 0-1 overrides it); fogSpeed = drift speed.
